story: Dan and Aiko are traveling to different countries. Dan goes to China by airplane, while Aiko goes to Spain to stay at a beach hotel. They both use different ways to travel.
title: A Big Trip
setting: An airport and a sunny beach.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Dan wakes up early for his big trip.
sentences.zh: Dan为了他的大旅行早早醒来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt, wakes up in a bed.

sentences.en: He buys a ticket for the airplane.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan holds a small paper ticket at an airport.

sentences.en: He will fly to China today.
sentences.scene_prompt: A large white airplane flies in the blue sky above Dan.

sentences.en: Aiko wants to stay in Spain.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress, looks at a map of Europe.

sentences.en: She looks at a map of the city.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko holds a large paper map in her hands.

sentences.en: She takes a taxi to the bus station.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko sits in a yellow taxi car near a bus station.

sentences.en: The bus drives on a long road.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车行驶在一条长路上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large blue bus drives on a gray road next to the ocean.

sentences.en: Aiko will ride a bike quickly.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko rides a small red bike quickly on the sand near the blue sea.
